title: The Blue Bird Sam Built
lines: Sam had a big pile of thin sticks in his room.
He built a bird from the sticks and glue.
It took him three days to get it right.
He made the bird blue with a few red dots.
The wings were thin, and the beak was sharp.
Sam held his blue bird up on the school steps.
Then a strong wind blew, and the bird flew!
It went up on a low roof by the steps.
Sam ran and got a long stick from the yard.
He held it up high, but the stick was short.
Next he stood up on a big wood box.
The stick still did not reach the blue bird.
Sam sat on the steps to think.
Then he ran in and got the tall broom.
He glued the stick to the broom.
That new tool was long, and it did reach.
Sam got his blue bird back on the steps.
He will keep it up high in his room.

questions.ask: How long did it take Sam to make the bird?
questions.listenFor: Three days. Find the line that starts "It took him" and let them read it to you.

questions.ask: How did Sam get the bird off the roof?
questions.listenFor: He glued his stick to a long broom so it would reach. The stick on its own was short.

questions.ask: Would you have made a bird from sticks? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Ask what they would make instead.
